meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 安装后,当你要整理会议纪要时,Claude 会用 lark-cli 按指定时间范围搜索会议、获取纪要元数据与文档链接,产出结构化报告(单日概览或周报);你要求时还可生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾某段时间的会议内容时触发。仅支持 user 身份,执行前需完成 vc 相关授权。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 默认汇总过去 7 天,先完成授权。

say.text: 把这些纪要生成一篇云文档
say.note: 调用 docs +create 创建文档。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses lark-cli to search meetings in a given time range, fetch note metadata and doc links, and produce a structured report (daily overview or weekly summary); it can also create a cloud doc on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a meeting weekly report, or review meetings over a period. Only the user identity is supported and authorization must be done first.

say_en.note: Summarizes the past 7 days by default.

say_en.text: What meetings did I have today?
Turn these notes into a cloud doc
